dogecoin.text:
The current case will most likely depend on the outcome of the trademark applications filed by Dogecoin Foundation.
 
Regardless, we will have to wait for Dogetipbot LLC to respond to the opposition notice by May 16, 2022. Failing to do so will lead to the trademark abandonment.
In the opposition notice, they claim common #law #trademark rights over the name “ #Dogecoin” and list their multiple pending trademark #applications in support of this claim.
Dogecoin had originally been created to mock the popularity of cryptocurrencies, which is understandably why the founders had not foreseen its success.

The 80-billion-dollar #cryptocurrency is currently fighting for its intellectual property rights which is at odds with its initial posture. 

#dogecoin #trademark

The #Dogecoin #Trademark #Fight
 
On April 6, the initial creators of Dogecoin, the #Dogecoin Foundation, sought to prevent the registration of Dogetipbot by Dogetipbot LLC by filing a trademark opposition with the #USPTO.
